fullDescription: Playful illustrated 'sunny sky' startup-website landing page for an AI design agent: cream paper base with a sky-blue + coral duo-tone, rounded Poppins type, a hand-illustrated hero scene (layered SVG hills, floating clouds, sun, tiny rooftop town, founder mascots), sticky blurred nav, two-up feature cards, a numbered 3-step how-it-works band, stats row, a gallery strip, and a deep-sky rounded CTA banner.

structured.summary: A playful, illustrated 'sunny sky' startup-website landing page for an AI design agent that turns a one-sentence brief into a full site on an infinite canvas. Cream-paper base with a friendly sky-blue + coral palette, rounded Poppins type, and a hand-illustrated hero scene (layered SVG rolling hills, floating clouds, a coral sun, a tiny rooftop town, evergreen trees, two waving founder mascots and a planted flag). Sticky blurred nav, a two-up product-feature row, a numbered 3-step 'how it works' band on white, a 4-up stats row, a 3-up 'made with' gallery strip, a deep-sky rounded CTA banner with floating clouds, and a 4-column footer. Subtle dotted paper grain over everything.

style.description: Playful illustrated 'sunny sky' style. Warm cream paper base (#fdf9f3) with a friendly duo-tone of sky blue (#38bdf8 / deep #0ea5e9 / ink #0c4a6e) and coral (#fb7185 / deep #f43f5e), near-black warm ink (#1f2433) for text. All-Poppins rounded geometric sans (weights 400-800, headings extrabold and tightly tracked). Generous soft rounded radii (custom 4xl 2rem and 5xl 2.75rem on cards/CTA, fully-rounded pill buttons), soft warm-tinted layered shadows plus a sky-blue 'glow' shadow on the logo/CTA, a faint radial-dot paper grain over the body, a hand-drawn coral SVG squiggle underline under one hero word, and gentle floating/blink keyframe animations on the illustration. Mood: cheerful, hand-drawn, friendly and reassuring, never corporate or cold.
style.prompt: Design in a playful illustrated 'sunny sky' style. Palette: cream paper base #fdf9f3, sky blue #38bdf8 (deep #0ea5e9, dark ink-blue #0c4a6e), coral #fb7185 (deep #f43f5e), warm near-black ink #1f2433 for text; illustration accents use light sky tints #bae6fd / #7dd3fc, rose #fda4af, emerald-400 for trees and a skin tone #f5d0b0 for the mascots. Type is all Poppins (Google Fonts, weights 400/500/600/700/800): headings extrabold (700-800) with tight -0.02em tracking, body in 400-500 at relaxed leading; secondary text in ink at ~65-70% opacity. Use soft rounded shapes everywhere: a custom 4xl (2rem) and 5xl (2.75rem) border radius on cards and the CTA banner, and fully-rounded pill buttons. Shadows are soft and warm-tinted ('soft' 0 18px 40px -20px rgba(31,36,51,0.22), 'softer' 0 10px 30px -18px rgba(31,36,51,0.18)) plus a sky-blue 'glow' (0 24px 60px -28px rgba(56,189,248,0.55)) on the logo badge and CTA. Layer a faint paper grain over the whole body via a radial-dot background (rgba(31,36,51,0.05) 1px dots on a 22px grid). Add hand-drawn warmth: a coral SVG squiggle stroke underlining one hero word, and gentle CSS keyframe animations (slow/mid 'float' bob on clouds & mascots, a periodic 'blink' on a mascot face). Keep it cheerful, friendly, reassuring and a little whimsical, never neon, corporate or clinical.

layout_and_structure.description: Single-column long-form landing page centered in a max-w-6xl (and tighter max-w-5xl / max-w-3xl) container with px-6 gutters. Top-down order: sticky blurred header nav, a centered hero (eyebrow pill, big headline with a doodle-underlined word, sub-paragraph, two pill CTAs, reassurance line) sitting above a full-width hand-illustrated sky scene (gradient sky band, layered SVG hills, floating clouds, sun, rooftop town, trees, two founder mascots, a planted flag); a centered sub-statement; a two-up feature-card row; a 'how it works' band on white with three numbered step cards and a 4-up stats row; a 'made with' gallery strip (3 project cards); a deep sky-ink rounded CTA banner with floating clouds and a star; and a 4-column footer with a bottom bar. Responsive: nav links hide below md, hero headline scales down and the illustration band shrinks in height, grids collapse (features 2->1, steps 3->1, stats 4->2, gallery 3->2) and CTAs stack on mobile.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (z-50) with a translucent cream background (bg-cream/85) + backdrop blur and a thin ink/5 bottom border. Inside a max-w-6xl row, height 72px: left = a 9x9 rounded-2xl sky-blue badge (rotated -6deg, with the sky-blue 'glow' shadow) holding a white ph:cloud-sun-fill icon, next to the 'Driftly' wordmark in extrabold Poppins; center = medium-weight text links (Features, How it works, Gallery, Pricing) in ink/70 that darken on hover, hidden below md; right = a 'Log in' text link (hidden on the smallest screens) and a fully-rounded dark ink pill CTA 'Start free' in cream text with a ph:arrow-up-right-bold icon that nudges up on hover.

A centered hero block in max-w-6xl with generous top padding. Top: a white rounded-full eyebrow pill with a sky/20 ring and softer shadow, a coral ph:sparkle-fill icon and the label 'The AI design agent for founders' in sky-ink. Then a huge extrabold Poppins headline (clamp up to ~68px, tight -0.02em tracking, leading 1.06): 'Build a startup site that looks funded on day one', where the word 'funded' is sky-ink and underlined by a hand-drawn coral SVG squiggle (a single curved <path> stroked #fb7185, 5px round caps). Below: a max-w-xl sub-paragraph in ink/70 ('Describe your product in a sentence. Driftly drafts the hero, the features, the pricing, all of it, on an infinite canvas you can drag and remix.'), then two pill CTAs (solid coral 'Generate my site' with a ph:magic-wand-fill icon + soft shadow, and a white ring-1 ink/10 'Watch it draw' with a sky-deep ph:play-circle-fill icon), then a tiny reassurance line 'No credit card. 50 free generations.'

A full-width illustrated sky scene below the hero copy (~470px tall on desktop, shorter on mobile). Background: a top-to-bottom gradient from sky/30 through sky/12 to cream. Layer in: three white ph:cloud-fill clouds at different sizes/positions with a slow/mid 'float' bob and drop shadow; a coral ph:sun-fill sun floating top-right; three stacked rolling-hill SVG paths filling the bottom (back hill #bae6fd, mid hill #7dd3fc, front hill #fda4af) drawn with preserveAspectRatio none so they stretch full-width. On the ridges sit a tiny 'town' of rounded-top rectangle buildings in coral-deep / white (sky/30 ring) / sky-ink / coral, two evergreen trees (emerald-400 ph:tree-fill / ph:tree-evergreen-fill), and two round-headed founder mascots: one coral body with a raised waving arm (a rotated coral pill forearm with a skin-tone hand circle) and a ph:smiley-fill face that periodically blinks, one sky-deep body holding a little white rounded tile with a coral ph:rocket-launch-fill icon. A coral flag on an ink pole floats (slow bob) in the center. Heads are skin-tone (#f5d0b0) circles ringed in white.

A short centered statement block in max-w-3xl just under the illustration: an extrabold Poppins heading ('No designer, no problem. Just powerful, playful tools.') and a one-line ink/65 sub-paragraph ('Two ways to drive Driftly, both built for people who would rather ship than fuss with pixels.').

A two-up feature row in max-w-5xl (md:grid-cols-2, gap-6). Each card is rounded-4xl white with a soft shadow and ink/5 ring and lifts (-translate-y-1) on hover. Card header = a rounded-2xl tinted icon tile (card 1: sky/15 bg, sky-deep ph:browsers-fill; card 2: coral/15 bg, coral-deep ph:terminal-window-fill) next to a bold title ('Canvas studio' / 'Agent skill'). Body = a ~15.5px ink/65 paragraph (canvas studio: prompt once, get a full site on an infinite canvas, drag sections, branch variations; agent skill: call the Driftly skill from Claude Code or Cursor to drive the same canvas from your editor). Footer = a fully-rounded solid pill link (card 1 sky-deep, card 2 coral) with a ph:arrow-right-bold icon whose gap widens on group hover.

prompts.partPt: How it works + Números e Resultados
prompts.prompt: A full-bleed white band with ink/5 top+bottom borders (max-w-6xl inner, py-20/24). Centered header: a sky/12 pill eyebrow with a ph:path-fill icon ('Three steps to live'), an extrabold heading 'From sentence to shippable', and a sub-line. Below, a 3-up grid of cream rounded-4xl step cards (the middle card nudged up -translate-y-3 on desktop); each card has a -top-4 left-8 numbered circular badge (1 sky / 2 coral / 3 ink-with-cream-text), a rounded-3xl tinted icon tile (sky/15 ph:chat-teardrop-text-fill, coral/15 ph:cursor-click-fill, ink/8 ph:export-fill), a bold title (Describe it / Remix it / Ship it) and a short ink/65 body. Beneath, a 4-up stats row (2 cols on mobile) of big extrabold numbers with small ink/70 labels: '10 min' (ink) blank page to live, '40k+' (sky-ink) sites generated, '98%' (rose-600) ship without a designer, '$0' (ink) to start drawing.

A 'Made with Driftly' gallery section in max-w-6xl. Header row (flex, wraps): an extrabold heading + a one-line ink/65 sub, and a right-aligned sky-ink text link 'Browse the library' with a ph:arrow-right-bold whose gap widens on hover. Below, a responsive card grid (2 / md:3, gap-5): each card is rounded-4xl white with an ink/5 ring and softer shadow, a 40-tall gradient thumbnail header centering a single Phosphor icon (sky gradient ph:chart-line-up-fill, coral gradient ph:bag-fill, ink gradient ph:device-mobile-fill), and a small body with a bold project name + a muted category line (Northwind Analytics / B2B SaaS landing, Fern & Folk / DTC storefront, Hush Budget / Mobile app site).

A friendly CTA banner in max-w-6xl: a rounded-5xl deep sky-ink (#0c4a6e) block with the sky-blue 'glow' shadow, decorated with two large floating white/translucent ph:cloud-fill clouds bleeding off the corners and a small coral ph:star-fill. Centered content: an extrabold white headline 'Your site is one sentence away.', a max-w-lg white/90 sub-paragraph ('Start with 50 free generations. Ping us anytime if you get stuck, and we'll sort it together.'), and two pill CTAs (a solid cream 'Generate my site' with a coral ph:magic-wand-fill and soft shadow, and a translucent white/15 ring-1 white/30 'Talk to a human').

A white footer with an ink/5 top border. max-w-6xl 4-column grid (md:grid-cols-4): first column = the rotated sky-blue cloud-sun badge + 'Driftly' wordmark, a short tagline ('Startup sites that look funded, drawn by an AI design agent.'), and three round social icon links (ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:youtube-logo) that turn sky-deep on hover; three link columns (Product / Resources / Company) each with a uppercase wide-tracked ink/70 heading and ink/70 links that darken to ink on hover. A top-bordered bottom bar splits a playful copyright ('© 2026 Driftly. Made on a sunny afternoon.') from a tagline ('Built for founders who would rather ship.').

special_ui_components.prompt: Hand-illustrated hero sky scene: a gradient sky band with three layered rolling-hill SVG paths (#bae6fd / #7dd3fc / #fda4af, preserveAspectRatio none), floating ph:cloud-fill clouds, a coral ph:sun-fill, a tiny rooftop town of rounded-top rectangles, emerald evergreen trees, and two round-headed founder mascots (one waving with an articulated rotated-pill arm + skin-tone hand, one holding a rocket tile) plus a planted coral flag
Hand-drawn coral squiggle underline: an inline SVG <path> stroked #fb7185 (5px round caps) sitting under the hero word 'funded'
CSS keyframe motion: 'floaty' slow (7s) and mid (5.5s) up-down bob on clouds, sun, mascots and flag; a periodic 'blink' (scaleY) on a mascot's smiley face
Paper-grain texture: a radial-dot background (rgba(31,36,51,0.05) 1px dots on a 22px grid) layered over the whole body

Phosphor (Iconify ph:*) icons throughout: cloud-sun, cloud, sun, sparkle, magic-wand, play-circle, arrow-up-right, arrow-right, browsers, terminal-window, path, chat-teardrop-text, cursor-click, export, chart-line-up, bag, device-mobile, star, tree, tree-evergreen, rocket-launch, smiley, and X/GitHub/YouTube social logos
Pill buttons (fully rounded) in several variants: solid coral, solid sky-deep, solid dark ink, solid cream, white-with-ring ghost, and translucent white/15 ghost
Numbered step cards with a -top-4 overlapping circular number badge (sky / coral / ink) and rounded-3xl tinted icon tiles; the middle card vertically offset (-translate-y-3) on desktop
Custom rounded radii: 4xl (2rem) on feature/step/gallery cards and 5xl (2.75rem) on the CTA banner; tinted icon tiles in sky/15, coral/15 and ink/8
Sky-blue 'glow' shadow (0 24px 60px -28px rgba(56,189,248,0.55)) on the logo badge and CTA banner, plus warm-tinted 'soft' / 'softer' layered shadows on cards and pills

structured.special_notes: Font loaded from Google Fonts: Poppins (weights 400/500/600/700/800) used for everything as the rounded geometric sans. Styled with Tailwind via the CDN (cdn.tailwindcss.com) using a custom theme: colors cream #fdf9f3, sky {DEFAULT #38bdf8, deep #0ea5e9, ink #0c4a6e}, coral {DEFAULT #fb7185, deep #f43f5e}, ink #1f2433; custom borderRadius 4xl 2rem / 5xl 2.75rem; custom boxShadow soft / softer / glow. Icons via Iconify (code.iconify.design) using the Phosphor 'ph:*' set. html has scroll-behavior:smooth; the body carries the radial-dot 'grain' background. Animations are pure CSS keyframes (floaty, blink). The whole illustration (hills, clouds, town, mascots, flag) is built from divs + inline SVG, no external images. Keep the mood cheerful, hand-drawn, friendly and reassuring; never neon, corporate or cold.
